notes: Preserves all v2 source groups and splits. Legacy test predictions were seen in v2; this is regression evidence, not a new blind evaluation.
All selected user phone photos belong to one train-only outing. New web event groups are train-only.
Six new video evaluation frames were frozen before v3 training. They cover only I, A and other, not B/G1; within-video frames are correlated.
Review excludes generic plants, noticeboards, ambiguous classrooms and near-repeated shots. No synthetic photos are used.

v6 expansion: reviewed training-only architectural/scene negatives and distractor-person positive views. Earlier val/test IDs, labels, groups and source pixels stay fixed. No test errors are moved to training.
